explanation: A dense register dial: fires on nearly every word token inside an ongoing sentence of English expository prose, and gets stronger the more formal academic, scientific or technical wording precedes it in the context (study, patients, consisted, encodes, methodology). It peaks on the function word or verb that continues a clause (by, of, about, have, that, while) and is near zero on sentence-final periods, on the first tokens of a document, on code syntax and whitespace, and stays weak (below about a third of max) in casual or simple narrative English and in most non-English text.
